name: survey-qa
description: Compare a Forsta Decipher XML survey against a client questionnaire (Word/PDF) and surface QA findings.

tools.name: get_survey_model_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema for SurveyModel — use when constructing doc-side data for run_checks.

tools.name: parse_xml
tools.description: Parse a Decipher XML survey file into the unified SurveyModel (deterministic, no LLM).

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Compare an XML survey against a doc-side SurveyModel and return findings + summary.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List all registered QA checks with their IDs and descriptions.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Write a color-coded Excel QA report (Summary / Findings / Questions sheets).
